items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Sometimes he had Zip on clarinet.

ctx.x: Who was in Jack's band then?
Jack was on trombone. Had a mud carrier on trumpet. Had this boy Willie on clarinet. Sometimes he had Zip on clarinet. You heard him, Zip? Yeah, sure.
Willie, I don't know which Willie that is.
